_what: Names the person gives to the colours their calendars offer (src/workspace/colour-names.mjs), as DATA. The names are one account record under `record_key`, { <colour>: <name> }, so every device and every calendar shows the same names. `most_names` and `most_name_chars` bound what is kept. `read_days` is how many days of the calendar are read to learn which colours the person's calendars offer. `words` are every word the page shows.

words.title: Colour names
words.body: Give each calendar colour a name of your own. The names show wherever you pick a colour for an event.
words.failed: Your colours could not be loaded.
words.empty: Connect a calendar and the colours it offers show here.
